name: Waldorf Astoria Beverly Hills
insider_take: This gleaming tower on Wilshire Boulevard puts you at the epicenter of luxury, where Hollywood glamour meets Beverly Hills sophistication.
whats_special: The hotel's La Prairie Spa is the only one on the West Coast, offering exclusive Swiss skincare treatments. The rooftop pool deck provides stunning 360-degree views from Century City to the Hollywood Hills, while the property sits just steps from Rodeo Drive's world-famous luxury shopping district.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at La Prairie Spa in advance—it's incredibly popular with A-listers and fills up quickly, especially during awards season.
dont_miss: Evening cocktails at the rooftop bar during golden hour for breathtaking sunset views, and a morning stroll through the nearby Beverly Gardens Park to see the iconic Beverly Hills sign—both are quintessential Beverly Hills experiences within minutes of your room.
pros: Prime Rodeo Drive location with luxury shopping access
Iconic Waldorf Astoria service and hospitality standards
Elegant accommodations with modern Beverly Hills sophistication
Exclusive rooftop dining and entertainment venues
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects premium Beverly Hills location
Limited on-site parking in dense urban setting
